Facts:
- "Closer" is a song by Nine Inch Nails from the band's second studio album, "The Downward Spiral" (1994).
- "The Hand That Feeds" was Nine Inch Nails' first top 40 pop radio hit since "Closer" in 1994 and "Hurt" in 1995.
- "The Hand That Feeds" crossed over to pop radio and peaked at number 31 on the Billboard Hot 100.
- Mark Romanek's notable music videos include Nine Inch Nails' "Closer," Johnny Cash's "Hurt," Red Hot Chili Peppers' "Can't Stop," Madonna's "Bedtime Story," and Michael & Janet Jackson's "Scream."
- The music video for Justin Timberlake's "Can't Stop the Feeling!" was directed by Mark Romanek and released on May 16, 2016.
- The "Can't Stop the Feeling!" video follows Justin Timberlake dancing through everyday places during a typical day and was followed by many fan-made videos.
